@@name@@Death Sentence@@icon@@Death Sentence.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Thresh''' throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable]] to move or attack while it is in flight.@@description2@@The scythe catches the first enemy hit to deal magic damage, [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] and [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|reveal]] them for 1.5 seconds, and render them [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] for 0.4 seconds, as well as reduce ''Death Sentence's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] '''current''' cooldown by 2 seconds. '''Thresh''' will also mark the target ''Shackled'' for 1.5 seconds, during which he is unable to declare basic attacks, and is [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 20% for 1 second.@@description3@@While the target is [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunned]], '''Thresh''' tugs his hook towards him twice, once after a 0.1-second delay and again 0.6 seconds after that. With each tug, the target is pulled a short distance towards '''Thresh'''. After 0.5 seconds of hitting an enemy, or instantly after hitting a [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]], '''Thresh''' can recast the ability while the target is ''Shackled''.@@description4@@'''Recast - Deathly Leap:''' '''Thresh''' stops tugging his hook and [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the ''Shackled'' enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast ''[[File:Thresh Dark Passage.png|20xpx|border|link=Thresh#Dark Passage|An icon for Thresh's ability Dark Passage]] [[Thresh#Dark Passage|Dark Passage]]'' and ''[[File:Thresh Flay.png|20xpx|border|link=Thresh#Flay|An icon for Thresh's ability Flay]] [[Thresh#Flay|Flay]]'' during the dash.@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@
'''Magic Damage:'''
100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 (+ 90% AP)
@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 1100 • [[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 1040@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@Global • 3000@@width@@[[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 140@@speed@@1900 • 1400@@casttime@@0.5 • None@@cost@@70@@cooldown@@19 / 16.5 / 14 / 11.5 / 9@@targeting@@[[Direction-targeted|Direction]] • [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@True@@notes@@ * '''Thresh''' will track the target if they change locations. ** He will dash to the target's previous location if the target is too far away or moves beyond 2000 units. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * The pull that occurs with each of '''Thresh's''' tugs is a non-[[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] displacement that displaces the target toward him. '''Thresh''' will only tug if the target remains [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunned]] and he has not casted ''Deathly Leap''. ** '''Thresh''' will not tug his hook at all if the stun was not applied to the target. ** These displacements will not be resisted by [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immunity]] or [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|crowd control immunity]].(unexpected) ** The first tug occurs after the 0.1-second delay, while the second tug occurs after 0.7 seconds of the target being stunned (or 0.6 seconds from the end of the initial delay). ** The initial [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] debuff that is applied to the target upon hitting them is removed if the displacement from the first pull is interrupted. ** The target will not be pulled with the tugs if they are too close to '''Thresh'''. * ''Death Sentence'' cannot be recast while [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] or [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]]. * ''Death Sentence'' can be recast even while the target is [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]]. * ''Death Sentence'' will not [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] enemies that are [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immune]] or [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|immune to crowd control]] but the target will still be marked and '''Thresh''' is still granted the ability to recast for his dash. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block all of ''Death Sentence's'' effects, including the mark as well as prevent the cooldown reduction. * ''Death Sentence's'' [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] duration is affected by [[File:Tenacity icon.png|20px|link=Tenacity|An icon representing the keyword Tenacity]] [[:Tenacity|tenacity]] but the mark will always persist for 1.5 seconds, unless the target uses a [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleansing]] effect, in which case the mark is removed. * ''Death Sentence's'' [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] will persist even if '''Thresh''' dies before the duration ends. The tugs will not occur as '''Thresh''' is not alive. * The reveal lingers for 0.05 seconds after it ends. * ''Deathly Leap'' has a maximum cast range of ~3000 units. If '''Thresh''' or the target move a greater distance than this away from one another while the target is marked, ''Deathly Leap'' can still be cast but will fail to trigger the dash.(bug) * '''Thresh''' will turn his facing direction towards the cast direction only after ''Death Sentence's'' cast is complete. ** If '''Thresh''' is facing '''more''' than 90° away from the cast direction in either direction, he will turn to face ''exactly'' 90° away from the cast direction over the cast time, then turn towards the cast direction when the missile is fired. ** If '''Thresh''' is facing '''less''' than 90° away from the cast direction, he will keep his facing direction until the missile is fired. ** [http://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=33837947#post33837947 This prevents the enemy from knowing where exactly '''Thresh''' is aiming at before the cast animation is complete.] *''Death Sentence'' triggers on-cast effects (such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive) once at the start of the cast, and once at the end of the cast. It may trigger on-cast effects a third time when casting ''Deathly Leap''. ** This is because a separate spell is cast to prevent '''Thresh''' from facing towards the target direction immediately, which is (incorrectly) flagged to trigger on-cast effects.(bug) {| class="article-table" style="font-size:small; width:475px; padding: 1em; box-shadow: #0a1827 0px 0px 25px 15px;" ! colspan="2"| Type | style="width:275px;" | Cast time |- ! colspan="2"| Attacking | Disabled |- ! colspan="2" | Abilities | Disabled |- ! colspan="2" | Movement | Disabled |- ! rowspan="3" | Items !
